component.name: AppNest
component.summary: A clean, modern AppImage manager built with Rust, GTK4, and Libadwaita

description.p: AppNest is a high-performance Linux desktop application for managing, organizing, integrating, and launching AppImages.

Key features include an adaptive runtime execution engine (Direct Native, FUSE, and SquashFS Extracted fallback), drag-and-drop file import, SHA-256 checksum verification, and full GNOME Libadwaita desktop integration.
Initial release of AppNest with adaptive runtime, drag-and-drop, and Libadwaita UI.
